---
title: "Research workflow"
---

This workflow adapts the minimal reflowR layout. The renderer is explicitly
`rmarkdown::render_site`; neither `reflow_init()` nor workflowr is invoked.
Source revision, file hashes, changes and license are in
`../metadata/reflowr-template.json` and `../licenses/reflowR-MIT.txt`.

Review the project specification, analysis plan and variable mappings before
adding real data. Project creation does not read data, install dependencies,
initialize Git, render pages or approve an analysis.

From the project root, run `Rscript code/render_report.R` after installing
rmarkdown, knitr and Pandoc. This renders the reviewed placeholder pages and a
clearly labelled synthetic demonstration into `docs/`. Review any edits to these
R Markdown files before rendering: rendering intentionally executes their code.
Publication-specific outputs belong under `publications/`, with dataset IDs
referencing the shared registry. No study conclusions are generated here.
